body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest a Golem fist against one creature within 2 units. On a success, deal 1 Bludgeoning damage and move it 1 unit.

surges.html: On a success, move the target 1 unit or prevent it from moving 1 unit on its next turn.
Increase this Action's range by 2 units. If you fully manifest through it, the manifestation also gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

rider.title: GOLEM — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Golem.
